#!/bin/sh
set -eu
PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
src='inventorysync@10.100.218.10:/etc/inventory/app.conf'
dst='/etc/inventory/app.conf'
tmp=$(mktemp /etc/inventory/.app.conf.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
scp -q -i /root/.ssh/inventory_sync -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 "$src" "$tmp"
chown root:root "$tmp"
chmod 0640 "$tmp"
if [ -f "$dst" ] && cmp -s "$tmp" "$dst"; then
    rm -f "$tmp"
    trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
    logger -t inventory-config-sync 'app.conf already synchronized'
    exit 0
fi
mv -f "$tmp" "$dst"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
logger -t inventory-config-sync 'app.conf synchronized from node1'
